result.instructions: Tools for Bookeo, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Bookeo data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run bookeo_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run bookeo_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run bookeo_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. bookeo_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: bookeo_get_api_key_info
tools.title: Get API key info
tools.description: Show which Bookeo account the credentials belong to and which permissions were granted (e.g. bookings_rw_all, customers_r_all, availability_r). A cheap way to confirm the setup works. Bookeo: GET /settings/apikeyinfo.

tools.name: bookeo_get_business
tools.title: Get the business
tools.description: Get the business's name, contact details, address, website and description. Bookeo: GET /settings/business.

tools.name: bookeo_list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List the bookable products (tours, classes, courses, appointments) with their ids, type (fixed, fixedCourse, flexibleTime), duration, participant limits per people category, default rates and options. Bookeo: GET /settings/products.

type.description: Only this product type. Omit for all.

pageNavigationToken.description: Token from a previous response's info.pageNavigationToken, to fetch another page. Search parameters need not be repeated.

pageNumber.description: Page to fetch (1-based). Used together with pageNavigationToken.

tools.name: bookeo_list_people_categories
tools.title: List people categories
tools.description: List the participant categories the account uses (default Adults/Children/Infants plus custom ones like Students), with their ids and seats taken. Needed for peopleNumbers. Bookeo: GET /settings/peoplecategories.

tools.name: bookeo_list_resources
tools.title: List resources
tools.description: List resource types and their resources (guides, instructors, rooms, boats...) with ids. Bookeo: GET /settings/resources.

pageNavigationToken.description: Token from a previous response's info.pageNavigationToken, to fetch another page. Search parameters need not be repeated.

pageNumber.description: Page to fetch (1-based). Used together with pageNavigationToken.

tools.name: bookeo_get_availability_slots
tools.title: Get availability slots
tools.description: List available slots (eventId, start/end, seats available) for fixed and fixedCourse products in a time window of at most 31 days. Not for flexibleTime products — use bookeo_search_matching_slots for those. Bookeo: GET /availability/slots.

productId.description: Only this product. Omit for all fixed/fixedCourse products bookable by customers.

startTime.description: Search window start (required unless paging) — RFC 3339 date-time, e.g. 2026-10-01T09:00:00-04:00. The offset -00:00 means the account's local timezone.

endTime.description: Search window end, max 31 days after start (required unless paging) — RFC 3339 date-time, e.g. 2026-10-01T09:00:00-04:00. The offset -00:00 means the account's local timezone.

mode.description: Set to "backend" to act as a manager, relaxing customer-facing limits (time in advance, participant limits, change windows).

pageNavigationToken.description: Token from a previous response's info.pageNavigationToken, to fetch another page. Search parameters need not be repeated.

pageNumber.description: Page to fetch (1-based). Used together with pageNavigationToken.

tools.name: bookeo_search_matching_slots
tools.title: Search matching slots
tools.description: Find slots that can take a given party (participant counts per category, options, resources), with an estimated price. Works for all product types, including flexibleTime appointments. Window max 31 days. To page through results pass only pageNavigationToken (+ pageNumber). Read-only. Bookeo: POST /availability/matchingslots, GET /availability/matchingslots/{pageNavigationToken}.

productId.description: Product id (required for a new search).

startTime.description: Search window start (required for a new search) — RFC 3339 date-time, e.g. 2026-10-01T09:00:00-04:00. The offset -00:00 means the account's local timezone.

endTime.description: Search window end, max 31 days after start (required for a new search) — RFC 3339 date-time, e.g. 2026-10-01T09:00:00-04:00. The offset -00:00 means the account's local timezone.

peopleNumbers.description: Participant counts per people category (required for a new search).

peopleCategoryId.description: People category id, e.g. Cadults, Cchildren, Cinfants or a custom id (see bookeo_list_people_categories).

number.description: How many people of this category.

name.description: Option name, as an alternative to id.

value.description: Option value: "true"/"false" for on/off options, a number as a string, the chosen value's name, or free text.

resources.description: Resources (e.g. a specific guide or instructor) — for flexibleTime products.

mode.description: Set to "backend" to act as a manager, relaxing customer-facing limits (time in advance, participant limits, change windows).

pageNavigationToken.description: To fetch another page of a previous search: its info.pageNavigationToken. The other search fields are then ignored.

pageNumber.description: Page to fetch (1-based). Used together with pageNavigationToken.

tools.name: bookeo_list_bookings
tools.title: List bookings
tools.description: List bookings by start time (startTime+endTime) and/or by last change (lastUpdatedStartTime+lastUpdatedEndTime) — at least one pair is required, each spanning at most 31 days. Optionally filter by product, include canceled bookings, and expand customer/participant details. Bookeo: GET /bookings.

startTime.description: Only bookings starting on/after this (pair with endTime) — RFC 3339 date-time, e.g. 2026-10-01T09:00:00-04:00. The offset -00:00 means the account's local timezone.

endTime.description: Only bookings starting on/before this (max 31 days after startTime) — RFC 3339 date-time, e.g. 2026-10-01T09:00:00-04:00. The offset -00:00 means the account's local timezone.

lastUpdatedStartTime.description: Only bookings changed/created on/after this (pair with lastUpdatedEndTime) — RFC 3339 date-time, e.g. 2026-10-01T09:00:00-04:00. The offset -00:00 means the account's local timezone.

lastUpdatedEndTime.description: Only bookings changed/created on/before this (max 31 days) — RFC 3339 date-time, e.g. 2026-10-01T09:00:00-04:00. The offset -00:00 means the account's local timezone.

pageNavigationToken.description: Token from a previous response's info.pageNavigationToken, to fetch another page. Search parameters need not be repeated.

pageNumber.description: Page to fetch (1-based). Used together with pageNavigationToken.

tools.name: bookeo_get_booking
tools.title: Get a booking
tools.description: Get one booking by its booking number: product, times, participants, options, price, paid amount, status (canceled/accepted/noShow). Bookeo: GET /bookings/{bookingNumber}.

tools.name: bookeo_list_booking_payments
tools.title: List a booking's payments
tools.description: List the payments (and refunds, as negative amounts) received for one booking. Bookeo: GET /bookings/{bookingNumber}/payments.

pageNavigationToken.description: Token from a previous response's info.pageNavigationToken, to fetch another page. Search parameters need not be repeated.

pageNumber.description: Page to fetch (1-based). Used together with pageNavigationToken.

tools.name: bookeo_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List or search customers — by name, firstName, lastName or emailAddress — optionally only members/non-members or those created since a date. Bookeo: GET /customers.

searchText.description: Text to search for. Omit to list all.

createdSince.description: Only customers created since this time — RFC 3339 date-time, e.g. 2026-10-01T09:00:00-04:00. The offset -00:00 means the account's local timezone.

pageNavigationToken.description: Token from a previous response's info.pageNavigationToken, to fetch another page. Search parameters need not be repeated.

pageNumber.description: Page to fetch (1-based). Used together with pageNavigationToken.

tools.name: bookeo_get_customer
tools.title: Get a customer
tools.description: Get one customer: contact details, next/previous booking, number of bookings, cancellations and no-shows, membership and store credit. Bookeo: GET /customers/{id}.

tools.name: bookeo_list_customer_bookings
tools.title: List a customer's bookings
tools.description: List one customer's bookings, optionally between two dates. Bookeo: GET /customers/{id}/bookings.

pageNavigationToken.description: Token from a previous response's info.pageNavigationToken, to fetch another page. Search parameters need not be repeated.

pageNumber.description: Page to fetch (1-based). Used together with pageNavigationToken.

tools.name: bookeo_list_payments
tools.title: List payments
tools.description: List payments received in a time period, optionally by payment method. Refunds are included with a negative amount. Bookeo: GET /payments.

startTime.description: Period start — RFC 3339 date-time, e.g. 2026-10-01T09:00:00-04:00. The offset -00:00 means the account's local timezone.

endTime.description: Period end — RFC 3339 date-time, e.g. 2026-10-01T09:00:00-04:00. The offset -00:00 means the account's local timezone.

paymentMethod.description: Only this payment method (Bookeo spells cheque "checque").

paymentMethodOther.description: Custom method name — required when paymentMethod is "other".

pageNavigationToken.description: Token from a previous response's info.pageNavigationToken, to fetch another page. Search parameters need not be repeated.

pageNumber.description: Page to fetch (1-based). Used together with pageNavigationToken.

tools.name: bookeo_get_payment
tools.title: Get a payment
tools.description: Get one payment: amount, method, reason, received time, customer and gateway transaction id. Bookeo: GET /payments/{id}.

tools.name: bookeo_create_hold
tools.title: Hold seats (price check)
tools.description: Temporarily reserve the seats/resources for a draft booking (default 300 s, max 600 s) and get the FINAL price, taxes and amount payable. The recommended step before bookeo_create_booking: pass the returned hold id as previousHoldId there. Holds expire automatically. Bookeo: POST /holds.

eventId.description: Slot id from bookeo_get_availability_slots / bookeo_search_matching_slots. REQUIRED for fixed and fixedCourse products; optional for flexibleTime (use startTime instead).

startTime.description: Start time, for flexibleTime products when no eventId is given — RFC 3339 date-time, e.g. 2026-10-01T09:00:00-04:00. The offset -00:00 means the account's local timezone.

endTime.description: Optional forced end time for flexibleTime products (otherwise Bookeo computes the duration) — RFC 3339 date-time, e.g. 2026-10-01T09:00:00-04:00. The offset -00:00 means the account's local timezone.

customerId.description: Id of an EXISTING customer (see bookeo_list_customers).

customer.description: A NEW customer to create together with the booking. Use customerId instead for an existing customer.

peopleCategoryId.description: People category id, e.g. Cadults, Cchildren, Cinfants or a custom id (see bookeo_list_people_categories).

number.description: How many people of this category.

name.description: Option name, as an alternative to id.

value.description: Option value: "true"/"false" for on/off options, a number as a string, the chosen value's name, or free text.

resources.description: Resources (e.g. a specific guide or instructor) — for flexibleTime products.

externalRef.description: Your own reference for this booking (max 64 chars).

privateEvent.description: Reserve the entire event, if the product allows it.

holdDurationSeconds.description: How long to hold, in seconds (default 300, max 600).

previousHoldId.description: A previous hold in the same session, replaced by this one.

tools.name: bookeo_create_booking
tools.title: Create a booking
tools.description: Create a confirmed booking for an existing customer (customerId) or a new one (customer). fixed/fixedCourse products need an eventId from the availability tools; flexibleTime products take eventId or startTime. Pass previousHoldId to convert a hold. Does NOT record any payment. Reversible with bookeo_cancel_booking. Bookeo: POST /bookings.

eventId.description: Slot id from bookeo_get_availability_slots / bookeo_search_matching_slots. REQUIRED for fixed and fixedCourse products; optional for flexibleTime (use startTime instead).

startTime.description: Start time, for flexibleTime products when no eventId is given — RFC 3339 date-time, e.g. 2026-10-01T09:00:00-04:00. The offset -00:00 means the account's local timezone.

endTime.description: Optional forced end time for flexibleTime products (otherwise Bookeo computes the duration) — RFC 3339 date-time, e.g. 2026-10-01T09:00:00-04:00. The offset -00:00 means the account's local timezone.

customerId.description: Id of an EXISTING customer (see bookeo_list_customers).

customer.description: A NEW customer to create together with the booking. Use customerId instead for an existing customer.

peopleCategoryId.description: People category id, e.g. Cadults, Cchildren, Cinfants or a custom id (see bookeo_list_people_categories).

number.description: How many people of this category.

name.description: Option name, as an alternative to id.

value.description: Option value: "true"/"false" for on/off options, a number as a string, the chosen value's name, or free text.

resources.description: Resources (e.g. a specific guide or instructor) — for flexibleTime products.

externalRef.description: Your own reference for this booking (max 64 chars).

privateEvent.description: Reserve the entire event, if the product allows it.

previousHoldId.description: Hold id from bookeo_create_hold; it is released on success.

notifyCustomer.description: Send the customer a confirmation email.

sendCustomerReminders.description: Send the customer reminders before the booking.

sendCustomerThankyou.description: Send the customer a thank-you after the booking.

mode.description: Set to "backend" to act as a manager, relaxing customer-facing limits (time in advance, participant limits, change windows).

tools.name: bookeo_update_booking
tools.title: Update a booking
tools.description: Change an existing booking — reschedule (eventId or startTime/endTime), change participant counts, options, resources or external reference. Fetches the current booking and sends it back with only your changes applied (Bookeo's PUT takes the full booking). Bookeo: GET then PUT /bookings/{bookingNumber}.

eventId.description: New slot id (reschedule a fixed/fixedCourse booking).

startTime.description: New start time (flexibleTime) — RFC 3339 date-time, e.g. 2026-10-01T09:00:00-04:00. The offset -00:00 means the account's local timezone.

endTime.description: New end time (flexibleTime) — RFC 3339 date-time, e.g. 2026-10-01T09:00:00-04:00. The offset -00:00 means the account's local timezone.

peopleNumbers.description: New participant counts per category (replaces the current ones).

peopleCategoryId.description: People category id, e.g. Cadults, Cchildren, Cinfants or a custom id (see bookeo_list_people_categories).

number.description: How many people of this category.

name.description: Option name, as an alternative to id.

value.description: Option value: "true"/"false" for on/off options, a number as a string, the chosen value's name, or free text.

resources.description: Resources (e.g. a specific guide or instructor) — for flexibleTime products.

notifyUsers.description: Email/SMS the business's staff about the change.

notifyCustomer.description: Email the customer about the change.

mode.description: Set to "backend" to act as a manager, relaxing customer-facing limits (time in advance, participant limits, change windows).

tools.name: bookeo_cancel_booking
tools.title: Cancel a booking
tools.description: Cancel a booking. It stays in the system (visible with includeCanceled) but frees its seats. The account's cancellation policy is NOT applied, so no cancellation fee is charged. Bookeo: DELETE /bookings/{bookingNumber}.

reason.description: Why — included in the customer's cancellation email, if sent.

notifyCustomer.description: Email the customer about the cancellation.

trackInCustomerHistory.description: Count this in the customer's cancellation stats.

cancelRemainingSeries.description: If part of a recurring series, also cancel all following bookings.

tools.name: bookeo_create_customer
tools.title: Create a customer
tools.description: Create a customer record. Not needed before booking — bookeo_create_booking can create the customer inline. Bookeo: POST /customers.

languageCode.description: Preferred language, e.g. en_US (underscore, not dash).

tools.name: bookeo_update_customer
tools.title: Update a customer
tools.description: Update a customer's contact details. Fetches the current record and sends it back with only your changes applied (Bookeo's PUT takes the full customer). Bookeo: GET then PUT /customers/{id}.

languageCode.description: Preferred language, e.g. en_US (underscore, not dash).
